subject: Membership delivery issue at Pudong store
body: Hi, I'm writing about a problem with my membership plan delivery from the Shanghai Pudong Store. I ordered the membership a while back and was told it would come with some welcome materials, but when the package finally arrived it was missing things and honestly the whole thing felt thrown together. The box was kind of beat up too. I tried calling the store a couple times but kept getting passed around, and nobody really explained what happened or when I'd get the rest. I'm not sure if this is normal for memberships or what, but it's been frustrating. Can someone look into it and let me know what's going on? Thanks.
